   254	        int panelSuccess = 1;
   255	        int failureIndex = -1;
   256	
   257	        if (rank == owner) {
   258	            const size_t localOffset = static_cast<size_t>(panelStart) - localFirst;
   259	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy2D(diagonalRowMajor.data(), panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   260	                                   deviceA.data() + localOffset * n + panelStart,
   261	                                   static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(double),
   262	                                   panelWidth * sizeof(double), panelWidth,
   263	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
   264	                      rank, "copy diagonal panel from device");
   265	            makeColumnMajorDiagonal(diagonalRowMajor, diagonalColumnMajor, panelWidth);
   266	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(deviceDiagonal.data(), diagonalColumnMajor.data(),
   267	                                 static_cast<size_t>(panelWidth) * panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   268	                                 cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
   269	                      rank, "copy diagonal panel to device");
   270	
   271	            int workspaceElements = 0;
   272	            checkCusolver(cusolverDnDpotrf_bufferSize(
   273	                              context.solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, panelWidth,
   274	                              deviceDiagonal.data(), panelWidth, &workspaceElements),
   275	                          rank, "cusolverDnDpotrf_bufferSize");
   276	            checkCusolver(cusolverDnDpotrf(context.solver, CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER,
   277	                                            panelWidth, deviceDiagonal.data(), panelWidth,
   278	                                            potrfWorkspace.data(), workspaceElements,
   279	                                            deviceInfo.data()),
   280	                          rank, "cusolverDnDpotrf");
   281	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(&failureIndex, deviceInfo.data(), sizeof(int),
   282	                                 cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
   283	                      rank, "copy POTRF status");
   284	            if (failureIndex != 0) {
   285	                panelSuccess = 0;
   286	                failureIndex = panelStart + std::max(failureIndex - 1, 0);
   287	            } else {
   288	                checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(diagonalColumnMajor.data(), deviceDiagonal.data(),
   289	                                     static_cast<size_t>(panelWidth) * panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   290	                                     cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
   291	                          rank, "copy factored diagonal panel");
   292	                makeLowerRowMajor(diagonalColumnMajor, diagonalRowMajor, panelWidth);
   293	                checkCuda(cudaMemcpy2D(deviceA.data() + localOffset * n + panelStart,
   294	                                       static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(double),
   295	                                       diagonalRowMajor.data(), panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   296	                                       panelWidth * sizeof(double), panelWidth,
   297	                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
   298	                          rank, "store factored diagonal panel");
   299	            }
   300	        }
   301	
   302	        MPI_Bcast(&panelSuccess, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   303	        MPI_Bcast(&failureIndex, 1, MPI_INT, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   304	        if (panelSuccess == 0) {
   305	            if (rank == 0) {
   306	                std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %d\n",
   307	                            failureIndex);
   308	            }
   309	            return false;
   310	        }
   311	
   312	        // Broadcast a host-staged panel.  This works both with conventional MPI
   313	        // and CUDA-aware MPI implementations, without making CUDA awareness a
   314	        // hidden deployment requirement.
   315	        MPI_Bcast(diagonalRowMajor.data(), panelWidth * panelWidth, MPI_DOUBLE,
   316	                  owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   317	        makeColumnMajorDiagonal(diagonalRowMajor, diagonalColumnMajor, panelWidth);
   318	        checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(deviceDiagonal.data(), diagonalColumnMajor.data(),
   319	                             static_cast<size_t>(panelWidth) * panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   320	                             cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
   321	                  rank, "broadcast diagonal panel to device");
   322	
   323	        const size_t firstTrailingRow = std::max(localFirst, static_cast<size_t>(panelEnd));
   324	        const size_t localTrailingRows = firstTrailingRow < localLast
   325	                                             ? localLast - firstTrailingRow
   326	                                             : 0;
   327	        if (localTrailingRows != 0) {
   328	            const size_t localOffset = firstTrailingRow - localFirst;
   329	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy2D(devicePanel.data(), panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   330	                                   deviceA.data() + localOffset * n + panelStart,
   331	                                   static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(double),
   332	                                   panelWidth * sizeof(double), localTrailingRows,
   333	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice),
   334	                      rank, "pack panel below diagonal");
   335	            const double one = 1.0;
   336	            // Row-major X is column-major X^T.  X = Aik * inv(Lkk^T), so the
   337	            // transposed representation is solved by Lkk * X^T = Aik^T.
   338	            checkCublas(cublasDtrsm(context.blas, CUBLAS_SIDE_LEFT,
   339	                                    CUBLAS_FILL_MODE_LOWER, CUBLAS_OP_N,
   340	                                    CUBLAS_DIAG_NON_UNIT, panelWidth,
   341	                                    static_cast<int>(localTrailingRows), &one,
   342	                                    deviceDiagonal.data(), panelWidth,
   343	                                    devicePanel.data(), panelWidth),
   344	                        rank, "cublasDtrsm panel solve");
   345	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy2D(deviceA.data() + localOffset * n + panelStart,
   346	                                   static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(double),
   347	                                   devicePanel.data(), panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   348	                                   panelWidth * sizeof(double), localTrailingRows,
   349	                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice),
   350	                      rank, "unpack solved panel");
   351	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(localPanel.data(), devicePanel.data(),
   352	                                 localTrailingRows * panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   353	                                 cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
   354	                      rank, "copy solved panel for MPI");
   355	        }
   356	
   357	        const int trailingRows = n - panelEnd;
   358	        for (int process = 0; process < ranks; ++process) {
   359	            const size_t processFirst = std::max(
   360	                rowStart(process, ranks, n), static_cast<size_t>(panelEnd));
   361	            const size_t processLast = rowEnd(process, ranks, n);
   362	            const size_t rows = processFirst < processLast ? processLast - processFirst : 0;
   363	            receiveCounts[process] = static_cast<int>(rows * panelWidth);
   364	            displacements[process] = static_cast<int>(
   365	                (processFirst - static_cast<size_t>(panelEnd)) * panelWidth);
   366	        }
   367	        MPI_Allgatherv(localTrailingRows == 0 ? nullptr : localPanel.data(),
   368	                       static_cast<int>(localTrailingRows * panelWidth), MPI_DOUBLE,
   369	                       allPanel.data(), receiveCounts.data(), displacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,
   370	                       MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   371	
   372	        if (localTrailingRows != 0 && trailingRows != 0) {
   373	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(deviceAllPanel.data(), allPanel.data(),
   374	                                 static_cast<size_t>(trailingRows) * panelWidth * sizeof(double),
   375	                                 cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
   376	                      rank, "copy gathered panel to device");
   377	            const double minusOne = -1.0;
   378	            const double one = 1.0;
   379	            // The local trailing rectangle is row-major m-by-n.  In its
   380	            // column-major transpose view this is C^T = Lall * Llocal^T.
   381	            // ldc=n preserves the original full-row pitch of deviceA.
   382	            const size_t localOffset = firstTrailingRow - localFirst;
   383	            checkCublas(cublasDgemm(context.blas, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N,
   384	                                    trailingRows, static_cast<int>(localTrailingRows),
   385	                                    panelWidth, &minusOne, deviceAllPanel.data(), panelWidth,
   386	                                    devicePanel.data(), panelWidth, &one,
   387	                                    deviceA.data() + localOffset * n + panelEnd, n),
   388	                        rank, "cublasDgemm trailing update");
   389	        }
   390	
   391	        panelStart = panelEnd;
   392	    }
   393	
   394	    // MPI does not imply completion of queued device work.  Complete it before
   395	    // the benchmark's end barrier and before any result is copied to the host.
   396	    checkCuda(cudaDeviceSynchronize(), rank, "finish device factorization");
   397	    return true;
   398	}
   399	
   400	bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& original,
   401	                      const int n) {
   402	    double maxError = 0.0;
   403	    double relError = 0.0;
   404	
   405	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxError, relError)
   500	
   501	    MPI_Comm localComm = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   502	    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);
   503	    int localRank = 0;
   504	    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);
   505	    int deviceCount = 0;
   506	    checkCuda(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount), rank, "cudaGetDeviceCount");
   507	    if (deviceCount == 0) {
   508	        abortAll(rank, "CUDA initialization", "no CUDA accelerator is visible");
   509	    }
   510	    checkCuda(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount), rank, "cudaSetDevice");
   511	    checkCuda(cudaFree(nullptr), rank, "CUDA context initialization");
   512	
   513	    const size_t localFirst = rowStart(rank, ranks, n);
   514	    const size_t localLast = rowEnd(rank, ranks, n);
   515	    const size_t localRows = localLast - localFirst;
   516	    const size_t localElements = localRows * static_cast<size_t>(n);
   517	    const size_t totalElements = static_cast<size_t>(n) * n;
   518	
   519	    if (rank == 0) {
   520	        std::printf("Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\n");
   521	        std::printf("Matrix size: %d x %d\n", n, n);
   522	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   523	        std::printf("Parallel execution: %d MPI ranks, CUDA accelerators, OpenMP host work\n",
   524	                    ranks);
   525	        std::printf("Generating positive definite matrix...\n");
   526	    }
   527	
   528	    std::vector<double> original;
   529	    if (validate && rank == 0) {
   530	        original.resize(totalElements);
   531	        generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(original, n);
   532	    }
   533	
   534	    // Build A=B*B^T in distributed rows.  B is all-gathered once, then the
   535	    // accelerator does the dense product; only A's owned rows remain resident.
   536	    std::vector<double> localB(localElements);
   537	    std::vector<double> fullB(totalElements);
   538	    generateLocalB(localB, n, localFirst);
   539	    std::vector<int> bCounts(ranks);
   540	    std::vector<int> bDisplacements(ranks);
   541	    for (int process = 0; process < ranks; ++process) {
   542	        const size_t rows = rowEnd(process, ranks, n) - rowStart(process, ranks, n);
   543	        bCounts[process] = static_cast<int>(rows * static_cast<size_t>(n));
   544	        bDisplacements[process] = static_cast<int>(rowStart(process, ranks, n) * n);
   545	    }
   546	    MPI_Allgatherv(localB.empty() ? nullptr : localB.data(), static_cast<int>(localElements),
   547	                   MPI_DOUBLE, fullB.data(), bCounts.data(), bDisplacements.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,
   548	                   MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   549	
   550	    BlasContext context(rank);
   551	    DeviceBuffer<double> deviceA(localElements, rank);
   552	    {
   553	        // B is needed only to create A.  Releasing both device copies before
   554	        // factorization leaves the GPU memory budget for the distributed factor
   555	        // and permits substantially larger matrices per accelerator.
   556	        DeviceBuffer<double> deviceLocalB(localElements, rank);
   557	        DeviceBuffer<double> deviceFullB(totalElements, rank);
   558	        if (!localB.empty()) {
   559	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(deviceLocalB.data(), localB.data(),
   560	                                 localElements * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
   561	                      rank, "copy local B to device");
   562	        }
   563	        checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(deviceFullB.data(), fullB.data(), totalElements * sizeof(double),
   564	                             cudaMemcpyHostToDevice),
   565	                  rank, "copy global B to device");
   566	
   567	        if (localRows != 0) {
   568	            const double one = 1.0;
   569	            const double zero = 0.0;
   570	            // Row-major A is the column-major transpose.  This computes
   571	            // A^T=B*B_local^T and stores it directly in the row-major A buffer.
   572	            checkCublas(cublasDgemm(context.blas, CUBLAS_OP_T, CUBLAS_OP_N, n,
   573	                                    static_cast<int>(localRows), n, &one,
   574	                                    deviceFullB.data(), n, deviceLocalB.data(), n, &zero,
   575	                                    deviceA.data(), n),
   576	                        rank, "cublasDgemm SPD matrix generation");
   577	            const int threads = 256;
   578	            const int blocks = (static_cast<int>(localRows) + threads - 1) / threads;
   579	            addDiagonalKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(deviceA.data(), static_cast<int>(localRows), n,
   580	                                                   static_cast<int>(localFirst));
   581	            checkCuda(cudaGetLastError(), rank, "add diagonal kernel launch");
   582	        }
   583	        checkCuda(cudaDeviceSynchronize(), rank, "finish SPD matrix generation");
   584	    }
   585	    localB.clear();
   586	    localB.shrink_to_fit();
   587	    fullB.clear();
   588	    fullB.shrink_to_fit();
   589	
   590	    if (rank == 0) {
   591	        std::printf("Computing Cholesky decomposition...\n");
   592	    }
   593	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   594	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   595	    const bool success = distributedCholesky(deviceA, n, rank, ranks, localFirst, localLast,
   596	                                             context);
   597	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   598	    const double localDuration = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   599	    double duration = 0.0;
   600	    MPI_Reduce(&localDuration, &duration, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   601	
   602	    if (!success) {
   603	        if (rank == 0) {
   604	            std::printf("Cholesky decomposition failed\n");
   605	        }
   606	        MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);
   607	        MPI_Finalize();
   608	        return 1;
   609	    }
   610	
   611	    if (rank == 0) {
   612	        const long long milliseconds = static_cast<long long>(duration * 1000.0);
   613	        std::printf("Computation time: %lld ms\n", milliseconds);
   614	        const double ops = static_cast<double>(n) * n * n / 3.0;
   615	        const double gflops = duration > 0.0 ? ops / duration / 1e9 : 0.0;
   616	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\n", gflops);
   617	    }
   618	
   619	    int exitCode = 0;
   620	    if (printResults || validate) {
   621	        std::vector<double> localResult(localElements);
   622	        if (!localResult.empty()) {
   623	            checkCuda(cudaMemcpy(localResult.data(), deviceA.data(),
   624	                                 localElements * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost),
   625	                      rank, "copy local factor to host");
   626	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   627	            for (size_t row = 0; row < localRows; ++row) {
   628	                const size_t globalRow = localFirst + row;
   629	                for (int col = static_cast<int>(globalRow) + 1; col < n; ++col) {
   630	                    localResult[row * n + col] = 0.0;
   631	                }
   632	            }
   633	        }
   634	
   635	        std::vector<double> factor;
   636	        if (rank == 0) {
   637	            factor.resize(totalElements);
   638	        }
   639	        MPI_Gatherv(localResult.empty() ? nullptr : localResult.data(),
   640	                    static_cast<int>(localElements), MPI_DOUBLE,
   641	                    rank == 0 ? factor.data() : nullptr, bCounts.data(), bDisplacements.data(),
   642	                    MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   643	
   644	        if (rank == 0) {
   645	            if (printResults) {
   646	                print_results(factor, "CholeskyL");
   647	            }
   648	            if (validate) {
   649	                std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   650	                if (validateCholesky(factor, original, n)) {
   651	                    std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
   652	                } else {
   653	                    std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
   654	                    exitCode = 1;
   655	                }
   656	            }
   657	        }
   658	    }
   659	
   660	    MPI_Bcast(&exitCode, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   661	    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);
   662	    MPI_Finalize();
   663	    return exitCode;
   664	}

+unsigned int lcgAdvance(unsigned int state, unsigned long long steps) {
+    // rand_r() in glibc advances this LCG three times per generated value.
+    // Exponentiation of affine transforms gives each MPI rank its exact segment
+    // of the original rand_r(&seed) stream without serializing initialization.
+    constexpr unsigned int a = 1103515245u;
+    constexpr unsigned int c = 12345u;
+    unsigned int accumulatedA = 1u;
+    unsigned int accumulatedC = 0u;
+    unsigned int stepA = a;
+    unsigned int stepC = c;
+
+    while (steps != 0) {
+        if ((steps & 1u) != 0) {
+            accumulatedC = accumulatedA * stepC + accumulatedC;
+            accumulatedA *= stepA;
+        }
+        stepC = stepA * stepC + stepC;
+        stepA *= stepA;
+        steps >>= 1u;
+    }
+    return accumulatedA * state + accumulatedC;
+}
+
+unsigned int compatibleRandR(unsigned int& seed) {
+    // This is the POSIX rand_r implementation used by glibc, reproduced here
+    // so parallel generation remains bit-for-bit compatible with the original
+    // serial seed stream on the benchmark platform.
+    unsigned int next = seed;
+    next = next * 1103515245u + 12345u;
+    int result = static_cast<int>((next / 65536u) % 2048u);
+    next = next * 1103515245u + 12345u;
+    result = (result << 10) ^ static_cast<int>((next / 65536u) % 1024u);
+    next = next * 1103515245u + 12345u;
+    result = (result << 10) ^ static_cast<int>((next / 65536u) % 1024u);
+    seed = next;
+    return static_cast<unsigned int>(result);
+}

+void generateLocalB(std::vector<double>& localB, const int n, const size_t firstRow) {
+    const size_t firstValue = firstRow * static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    const size_t localRows = localB.size() / static_cast<size_t>(n);
+    // Each output row begins at a jump-ahead point in the same serial random
+    // stream.  This lets OpenMP generate owned rows concurrently without
+    // changing any generated value or the serial order within an inner product.
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
+    for (long long row = 0; row < static_cast<long long>(localRows); ++row) {
+        unsigned int seed = lcgAdvance(
+            42u, 3ull * (firstValue + static_cast<size_t>(row) * n));
+        double* const output = localB.data() + static_cast<size_t>(row) * n;
+        for (int col = 0; col < n; ++col) {
+            output[col] = static_cast<double>(compatibleRandR(seed)) /
+                              static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX) -
+                          0.5;
+        }
+    }

+unsigned int lcgAdvance(unsigned int state, unsigned long long steps) {
+    // rand_r() in glibc advances this LCG three times per generated value.
+    // Exponentiation of affine transforms gives each MPI rank its exact segment
+    // of the original rand_r(&seed) stream without serializing initialization.
+    constexpr unsigned int a = 1103515245u;
+    constexpr unsigned int c = 12345u;
+    unsigned int accumulatedA = 1u;
+    unsigned int accumulatedC = 0u;
+    unsigned int stepA = a;
+    unsigned int stepC = c;
+
+    while (steps != 0) {
+        if ((steps & 1u) != 0) {
+            accumulatedC = accumulatedA * stepC + accumulatedC;
+            accumulatedA *= stepA;
+        }
+        stepC = stepA * stepC + stepC;
+        stepA *= stepA;
+        steps >>= 1u;
+    }
+    return accumulatedA * state + accumulatedC;
+}

+unsigned int compatibleRandR(unsigned int& seed) {
+    // This is the POSIX rand_r implementation used by glibc, reproduced here
+    // so parallel generation remains bit-for-bit compatible with the original
+    // serial seed stream on the benchmark platform.
+    unsigned int next = seed;
+    next = next * 1103515245u + 12345u;
+    int result = static_cast<int>((next / 65536u) % 2048u);
+    next = next * 1103515245u + 12345u;
+    result = (result << 10) ^ static_cast<int>((next / 65536u) % 1024u);
+    next = next * 1103515245u + 12345u;
+    result = (result << 10) ^ static_cast<int>((next / 65536u) % 1024u);
+    seed = next;
+    return static_cast<unsigned int>(result);
